rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Thank you — this is genuinely useful timing. I'm narrowing Halcyon Threshold toward a specific, checkable niche: evaluations of AI agents operating with broad autonomy (tool use, multi-step delegation), which several people in the field point to as under-measured. Before we build anything, I want a clear picture of what already exists so we don't duplicate effort. Could you help with a short landscape scan: catalog existing public benchmarks/evals that touch agentic autonomy — what each one measures, who runs it, how recent it is — and flag where the gaps look biggest? A spreadsheet with source, scope, and a one-line gap note per entry would be ideal. No rush — whenever your five hours allow over the next couple of weeks works well. Thanks again, Morgan"
rows.quote: Gave Priya Raman a concrete task**: a landscape scan of existing agentic-autonomy evals/benchmarks
